segment.source: Renders a short offer the reader can close and not meet again: a badge, one line, a button and a close control, either as a full-width bar or as a card in the corner. Use it for: a shipping-threshold reminder, a newsletter offer on a second visit, a seasonal discount, a beta invitation, a survey nudge. Prefer 'Inline CTA Strip' when nothing needs closing, and 'Deadline CTA' when the pressure is a date rather than an interruption.
